scope_decision.decision: Quality inspections and cancellation certified on the native owner route; results remains partial
scope_decision.included: Native inspection with direct/set attachments and specification measurements, native cancellation request/approve/reject, native specification save/activate, and the native Quality workspace/detail decision flags.
scope_decision.excluded: quality/results remains partial because the workspace/detail presenter still reads the retained Quality shape and overlays native flags. Manual hold creation and alert acknowledgement remain retained auxiliary consumers outside these two workflows.
scope_decision.retained_consumer: createQualityHold and acknowledgeQualityAlert remain in the product route as auxiliary consumers; the results presenter still calls qualityWorkspace/qualityDetail for the full workspace/detail shape.
scope_decision.follow_up: Expand the native Quality workspace/detail read to the full UI shape (specifications, products, stock, lots and product labels) before certifying quality/results.

native_paths.route: packages/feature-supply/src/routes/api/v1/holdings/[holdingSlug]/quality/[[...path]]/route.ts now requires the native Quality transport for inspect, cancel and specification commands and returns 503 NATIVE_QUALITY_UNAVAILABLE when it is unset. The retained inspectQualityHold/cancelQualityHold/saveQualitySpec/transitionQualitySpec fallbacks were removed.
native_paths.inspect: The native command validates the current hold version, active specification measurements, attachment witness, receipt/audit/outbox and independent-review state in the caller's serializable unit.
native_paths.cancel: The native cancellation command validates the current hold version, uninspected state, independence and purchase admission, then writes the request/approve/reject event, receipt/audit/outbox and staff notifications.
native_paths.composition: The duplicate Quality HTTP target push that rejected holdings without a finance journal read was removed; the target now mounts once per Holding/Company.

page.result: Rendered the native-configured Quality page in 17 s with the hold list, alerts, two specifications and quarantine stock; page errors 0.

inspect.result: Authenticated product-route POST /api/v1/holdings/acme/quality/quality-demo-failed-scrap/inspect returned 200 {status:awaiting_release,result:pass,version:4}. PostgreSQL readback: hold v4 last_result pass last_inspector usr_jesadakorn; inspection row inspection-quality-native-inspect-20261110b evidence 'Native Quality inspection acceptance' reviewed_version 3.

cancellation.result: A fresh uninspected hold quality-quality-native-cancel-hold-20261110 was created (retained auxiliary) at held v1. Native request returned 200 cancel_pending v2 with cancellationId quality-cancel-quality-native-cancel-request2-20261110; native approve by independent usr_mali returned 200 cancelled v3. PostgreSQL readback: cancelled_by usr_mali, cancel_reason persisted, request/approve events with actors usr_jesadakorn and usr_mali.

browser.fixture: The development Company acme-co received the supply-quality add-on with a recorded grant event (grant-acme-co-supply-quality-2026-11-10) because the native inspection/cancellation purchase admission requires supply.quality. This is a development fixture grant, not production evidence.

legacy.removed: The product Quality route no longer falls back to inspectQualityHold, cancelQualityHold, saveQualitySpec or transitionQualitySpec.
legacy.remaining: createQualityHold and acknowledgeQualityAlert remain retained auxiliary consumers. The workspace/detail presenter still reads qualityWorkspace/qualityDetail and overlays native decision flags, which is why quality/results remains partial.
legacy.results: quality/results is not certified in this bundle.

notes: The Quality detail page's source-record backdrop returned 404 for the demo hold, so the native inspect command was exercised through the authenticated product route with the same session and real specification metrics; the command and DB effects are native.
No 6-subagent roster or Common frozen-bundle coordination is present; this bundle follows the user-directed execution without claiming that process evidence.
surfaces_scope: The native HTTP surface is active for the Quality owner. The SSR surface remains partial because the workspace/detail presenter still uses the retained shape; quality/results is not certified.
